corpus: Pinned Godot demo projects for gpack experiments
inventory_method: Recursively count regular files below every project.godot directory in the pinned source snapshot; do not follow symlinks; include hidden regular files such as screenshots/.gdignore. Category median is computed before per-project release ZIP packaging.
selection_rule: One project per 2D, 3D, and audio category, nearest the category median regular-file count among projects with reviewed, clear notices. Break equal-distance ties by lowest third-party attribution burden, then lexicographic project path.
